about: The nicknames residents coin for a wolf's deeds (Docs/Design/56-fame-and-memory.md, 4), by the deed's family. One form is chosen by hash: an epithet or a possessive ({name}: the name the coiner knows the wolf by; never used for a wolf it knows only by look). Nicknames stay short: a "deed" list of forms ({deed}, a phrase such as "the wolf who drove the bandits off the road") is read if given, but none is (user, 2026-10-08). A nickname another wolf in the town already wears isn't used. Players can't pick their own.
